latest_release.name: vMLX 1.6.84
latest_release.body:
# vMLX 1.6.84

## Changes

- Publish vMLX 1.6.83 updater manifest (`b20e7513`)
- feat(ricursive): Ripple-65B runtime and DFlash2 text lane (`f6bd17ff`)
- fix(dflash2): text lane parity, rotating snapshot aliasing, drafter window (`0b33f432`)
- fix(ripple): lane-owned max_tokens, history reasoning separators, launch test (`abdfeec3`)
- perf(dflash2): lane matmul on text targets, exact Ripple verify attention (`aff7cfeb`)
- perf(ripple): sliding-window SSD deltas; no thinking/effort controls (`9b6d00ad`)
- test(dflash2): pin the lane matmul on text-only DFlash2 targets (`3e5a51d9`)
- perf(dflash2): keep the finished turn hot for an immediate continuation (`2f765a65`)
- perf(dflash2): cost-aware first observation cycle for codebook targets (`266f3bf4`)
- perf(dflash2): turn entries chain one link deeper; the next boundary rebases (`5a34bcac`)
- perf(dflash2): bound a windowed drafter's snapshot gap by its sliding window (`55630f99`)
- perf(dflash2): amortized SSD chain rebase (`8a18ea30`)
- perf(dflash2): a turn entry never pays the chain's whole rewrite (`645492a3`)
- fix(tools): find_files matches path-style globs (`103d1d9a`)
- perf(dflash2): Ripple gets its fastest settings from a plain load (`24e987e9`)
- perf(dflash2): AR steps stop paying for a 16-row tile; probes run on a time budget (`9b24d4e3`)
- perf(dflash2): split-K dense verify tile, drafter lane matmul, widths measured at load (`104007fa`)
- panel: footer row per model request of a tool exchange (`f88fe5e0`)
- panel: drop malformed fields from per-request footer rows (`9b94cf02`)
- fix: report Ripple native DFlash2 cache in health and Perf (`83d0dca0`)
- release: prepare Ripple scoped evidence gate for 1.6.84 (`89bbaa94`)

## Runtime provenance

- vMLX source: `8b3da66e11b87953758972a5cb4036ac1a982ddc`
- JANG runtime: `44f84d1347a3692cc2d8ec61e8223535f7b99791` (`jang 2.5.53`)
- Tahoe/macOS 26 is the default build; Sequoia is the compatibility build.
- Both DMGs are Developer ID signed, independently notarized, stapled, and Gatekeeper checked by the candidate workflow.
